failure_summary.description: Selected a related but incorrect referent, or repeated a roster instead of inferring the shared entity.
Returned an overbroad or overly specific answer, such as extra collaborators, a full title, a subtype, or a formal company name.

patch.reasoning: The skill already covers checking the full clue and using the requested granularity, so repeating those rules would not address the main gap. Bare rosters and quoted slogans or catchphrases need more explicit guidance: infer the shared work or conventional source, and do not mistake a derivative title or every named associate for the intended answer.

edits.content:
## Bare rosters and quoted slogans
- When a prompt is only a list of people or characters, use context to infer their shared work or group rather than repeating the list. When it is only a slogan or catchphrase, identify its conventional source or central referent; distinguish an originating work or principal candidate from a similarly worded adaptation or installment, and do not automatically include every collaborator named in the phrase unless the clue asks for the full group.
